这是一个面向具身智能研究者的开放研究地图。以技术关键词组织论文，通过有来源的关系: An open research atlas organized by technical keywords, connecting methods, datasets and people through sourced relationships.
研究方向涵盖动作策略、VLA、世界模型、导航与空间智能、运动控制、灵巧操作、仿真: Areas include action policies, VLA, world models, navigation, locomotion, dexterity, simulation and data. This is a curated selection, not an exhaustive or real-time index. Years generally follow the first preprint; venues are recorded separately.
实线代表有来源的方法扩展、蒸馏或资源使用；虚线是编辑推荐的同类比较。点击连线可检: Solid lines represent sourced extensions, distillation or resource use. Dashed lines group related approaches editorially. Select a link to inspect evidence. Paper authors are a selection and publication affiliations reflect the original work. Current public roles are separately verified in the people directory.
